_comment: Each slug below was verified live (curl'd the actual Greenhouse/Lever API) before being added, and had at least one real MuleSoft-related posting at verification time - unlike the big Indian IT-services firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini) and boutique MuleSoft partners (Apisero, Closeloop, Twistellar, Prowess Software), which don't run Greenhouse or Lever at all (guessed/searched slugs all 404'd - they use Workday or a custom portal instead). Range: innovationsolved/greenirony are small MuleSoft-focused boutique consultancies (startup-scale); ioconnectservices.com/ubiminds/gurobioptimization are small-to-mid integration/product shops; ciandt is a global IT consultancy (MNC-scale); axs/aegworldwide/monsterenergy are large recognizable consumer brands; twilio/yext/horizonindustrieslimited are mid-to-large product companies. This is NOT exhaustive - it's what surfaced across several search passes (mulesoft/dataweave/anypoint/mule-esb keyword searches, MuleSoft's own partner directory) each individually curl-verified. Add more the same way: open a company's real careers page, confirm the URL contains 'greenhouse.io' or 'jobs.lever.co', copy the slug in, then verify it resolves before trusting it.
